instructions.content: NEVER override Starlight styles without the `customCss` array
NEVER add raw Tailwind imports without the `@astrojs/starlight-tailwind` compatibility layer imported first
NEVER use `.dark` class selectors for dark mode; Starlight uses `data-theme="dark"`
NEVER mix `--sl-*` variables with Tailwind `@theme` overrides; choose one approach
NEVER wrap your overrides in a named layer that Starlight's layers outrank; unlayered CSS wins
NEVER drop the `@layer base, starlight, theme, components, utilities;` order declaration in the Tailwind setup
NEVER set a single accent variable and expect a full palette; set low, mid and high together
NEVER use this skill to replace UI sections such as header, footer or sidebar; use `starlight-custom-component`
Set `--sl-*` custom properties on `:root` in a custom CSS file and register it in `customCss`
Install the Tailwind compatibility package `@astrojs/starlight-tailwind` for the Tailwind approach
